faqs.question: Will this work with my laptop?
faqs.answer: If your laptop charges via a USB-C port, yes. Send us your laptop model on WhatsApp if you're not sure it charges over USB-C.

faqs.question: Is 65W enough for my laptop?
faqs.answer: 65W covers most ultrabooks and business laptops. Larger gaming or workstation laptops may need more — check your original charger's wattage or ask us.
